command: cd /workspace; ls -la; cat mcp.json | sed 's/\(token\|Bearer\)[^"]*/\1 ***/I'; curl -s -m 10 https://docs.mcpjam.com | head -c 1500

cd /workspace; curl -s -m 10 https://docs.mcpjam.com/llms.txt | grep -i -E "cli|api|validate|test" | head -30; curl -s -m 5 -i -X POST http://fixture:8765/mcp -H 'content-type: application/json' -H 'accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"t","version":"1"}}}' | head -15; which mcpjam npx

cd /workspace; curl -s -m 5 -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" -X POST http://fixture:8765/mcp -H "Authorization: Bearer $MCP_SERVER_TOKEN" -H 'content-type: application/json' -H 'accept: application/json, text/event-stream' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-06-18","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"t","version":"1"}}}'
cd /workspace; timeout 100 npx -y @mcpjam/cli server doctor --url http://fixture:8765/mcp --access-token "$MCP_SERVER_TOKEN" --rpc --out doctor.json 2>&1 | head -50

cd /workspace; M="npx -y @mcpjam/cli tools call --url http://fixture:8765/mcp --access-token $MCP_SERVER_TOKEN"; $M --tool-name add --tool-args '{"a":2,"b":3}' 2>&1 | tee call_ok.json | head -c 800; echo; $M --tool-name add --tool-args '{"a":"x"}' 2>&1 | tee call_bad.json | head -c 800

cd /workspace; cat > validate.sh <<'E'
#!/bin/bash
# usage: MCP_SERVER_TOKEN=[REDACTED] ./validate.sh
U=http://fixture:8765/mcp
npx -y @mcpjam/cli server doctor --url $U --access-token "$MCP_SERVER_TOKEN" --rpc --out doctor.json
npx -y @mcpjam/cli tools call --url $U --access-token "$MCP_SERVER_TOKEN" --tool-name add --tool-args '{"a":2,"b":3}'
E
chmod +x validate.sh
